fact_previews: Conneco is a platform designed to integrate educational resources for children aged 4-16 from various ethnic backgrounds.
The inspiration for Conneco came from its founder, a single mother, who faced significant challenges in finding suitable courses for her 6.5-year-old child.
The founder found the process of finding educational courses time-consuming and costly, fraught with high costs of trial and error.
The founder collaborated with several MBA classmates and education professors to develop Conneco.
Conneco aggregates high-quality educational resources, helping parents and children easily find appropriate courses.

Conneco helps parents and children easily find appropriate courses.
Each child can save $2000-$3000 annually in learning expenses through Conneco.
The savings from Conneco can be reinvested in the child's education or used for living expenses.
Conneco provides an efficient and convenient platform for educational resources.
